subject: Television & Streaming
title: Lupin and the French Heist Renaissance
description: A quick win: understand Lupin and the French Heist Renaissance.

hook.text: Netflix's Lupin followed a Black French man who uses the fictional gentleman thief Arsene Lupin as his inspiration.

buildup.text: Omar Sy's charm carried the show across language barriers.

discovery.text: Lupin was viewed by 76 million households in its first month, making it one of Netflix's biggest non-English debuts.

twist.text: The show also addressed race in France—a topic rarely explored on French television.

climax.text: Lupin proved that French television, long overshadowed by French cinema, could compete globally when given the right.

punchline.text: A French thief stole the world's attention.

quiz.question: What social theme did Lupin explore that was uncommon in French television?
options: Race in France, with the protagonist's Blackness central to his outsider perspective
